what: Round 33 hang (coord-1030, run log /tmp/blaze-lanes/self-run-1101-081613PST.log, stacks /tmp/blaze-lanes/sandbox-hang/*.sample): blaze-compiled build scripts of ring and zstd-sys (cc 1.4.3) sit in cc::parallel::async_executor::block_on -> thread::sleep forever with no clang child. In cc 1.4.3 src/parallel/command_runner.rs block_on polls spawn_future first, whose first step is job_token inprocess_jobserver::JobServer::acquire: `AtomicU32::new(NUM_JOBS=18).fetch_update(AcqRel, Acquire, |t| t.checked_sub(1))`, retried after `YieldOnce::default().await`. A spawn error would end the future Err and an empty cmd list would let block_on return, so the only way to sleep with no child is that acquire never succeeds: suspect blaze codegen of fetch_update/compare_exchange_weak on AtomicU32, checked_sub's Option<u32>, `"18".parse::<u32>()` (cargo_env_var_os NUM_JOBS), or the async state machine not keeping YieldOnce(bool)'s flag across polls (every poll Pending). Under rustc the same loop spawns clang at once. Suggested repro tests: those four in a blaze-built binary. Not the sandbox: the hang is before any spawn.
